claims.text: The empirical evaluation involved testing various classification models including Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine (SVM), logistic regression, and gradient boosting, with SVM yielding the best results.
A two-tailed paired t-test with a 0.05 significance level was used to test the statistical significance of performance differences between the models.
The performance was evaluated using the F1 score with ten-fold cross-validation on a dataset of fake news and satire articles.
